name: Frost Thrall
rules: Summon Frost Thrall: 16 HP / 6 Power. Attacks apply 1 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 16 HP / 6 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 1 Chill.
displayRules:
Summon a Thrall. 16 HP / 6 Power.
Attacks apply 1 Chill.
Rot starts at 1.
If you have 2 Corpses, spend them instead of Mana.
